registryCustodian.name: Ministère des Affaires foncières de la République démocratique du Congo — circonscription foncière de Kasangulu
registryCustodian.scope: Local land and cadastral administrative custodian listed for Kasangulu, Kongo-Central; the ministry also publishes the formal research-request route.
registryCustodian.evidence: The ministry's current circonscriptions directory lists Kasangulu among the 11 Kongo-Central circonscriptions. The research-request page requires a province and circonscription selection and describes processing by authorized land-search agents and competent conservators. This evidences a local registry/cadastre custodian, not public citywide vector access.
